entities.name: Yenny Álvarez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yenny Álvarez Caicedo is a Colombian weightlifter. She won the gold medal in the women's 59 kg event at the 2022 World Weightlifting Championships held in Bogotá, Colombia. In 2021, she won the silver medal in her event at the World Weightlifting Championships held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
